pr_body:
closes #10620 

Adds `reattach` flag to `ECSOperator` so that whenever the Airflow server restarts, it does not leave rogue ECS Tasks. Instead the operator will seek for any running instance and attach to it.

At [Button](https://www.usebutton.com/), we use a custom ECSOperator which we added this functionality.

issue_context.title: Reattach ECS Task when Airflow restarts
issue_context.body:
**Description**

In similar fashion to https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/4083, it would be helpful for Airflow to reattach itself to the ECS Task rather than letting another instance to start. However, instead of making this the default behavior, it would be better to use a `reattach` flag.

**Use case / motivation**

Allow Airflow the option to reattach to an existing ECS task when a restart happens, which would avoid having "rogue" tasks.

review_comments: Exactly. That's what I had in mind. Thanks.
